legal.privacy.a1:
When you use our contact form, we collect the following information:

  • Data collected: First and last name, email address, phone number (optional), your company name (optional), message.
  • Legal basis: Legitimate interest and explicit consent when submitting the form.
  • Purpose: Responding to your request, sending you a quote or information about our services.
  • Retention: 3 years from your last interaction with Alivaon.
legal.privacy.a10:
Alivaon works with international clients and partners. In this context, some data may be transferred to countries outside Cameroon. These transfers are governed by:

  • Standard contractual clauses compliant with the GDPR
  • Data processing agreements signed with each provider concerned
  • The safeguards provided by the applicable legislation in the recipient countries
legal.privacy.a11:
Alivaon may be required to disclose your personal data in the event of a legal obligation, a court decision or a request from a competent administrative authority in Cameroon or abroad.

Alivaon never sells your personal data to third parties.
legal.privacy.a12: You have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether or not data concerning you is being processed by Alivaon, as well as a copy of that data.
legal.privacy.a13: You may request the correction of any inaccurate or incomplete data concerning you in our systems.
legal.privacy.a14: You may request the deletion of your personal data, unless its retention is necessary for the performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, or the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
legal.privacy.a15: In certain cases (inaccurate data, unlawful processing, objection to processing), you may request the restriction of the processing of your data - it will be retained but not used.
legal.privacy.a16: You may receive the data concerning you in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, and transmit it to another data controller.
legal.privacy.a17: You may object at any time to the processing of your data for direct marketing purposes. For processing based on legitimate interest, your objection will be upheld unless compelling legitimate grounds prevail.
legal.privacy.a18:
To exercise your rights, contact us by email at contact@alivaon.com, stating your name, email address and the right you wish to exercise. Proof of identity may be requested to verify your identity.

We undertake to respond within 30 days of receiving your request. For complex requests, this period may be extended by a further 2 months, with prior notice.
legal.privacy.a2:
Following your enquiry, we send you transactional emails (acknowledgement of your request, response to your quote, etc.). These are sent via our email service provider.

  • Data processed: Email address, name, subject of the request.
  • Legal basis: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures.
  • You may unsubscribe at any time by writing to us at contact@alivaon.com.
legal.privacy.a3:
If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address in order to send you news about our services, blog articles and commercial offers.

  • Legal basis: Explicit consent (double opt-in).
  • Retention: Until you unsubscribe.
  • Unsubscribing: Via the unsubscribe link in every email, or by writing to us directly.
legal.privacy.a4:
Our server automatically collects browsing data for security and performance purposes:

  • IP address (anonymised after 7 days)
  • Browser type and operating system
  • Pages visited and visit duration
  • Connection time and date

Legal basis: Legitimate interest (security, fraud detection, performance). This data is not cross-referenced with other personal information.
legal.privacy.a5:
A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit our site. It stores certain information about your browsing and improves your user experience.

You can configure your browser to accept, refuse or delete cookies at any time. Refusing certain cookies may however limit some features of the site.
legal.privacy.a6:
These cookies are essential to the operation of the site. They do not require your consent.

  • Symfony session: Management of your user session (PHPSESSID). Duration: session.
  • CSRF token: Protection against cross-site request forgery attacks when submitting forms. Duration: session.
legal.privacy.a7:
With your consent, we use audience analytics tools to measure traffic and improve our site:

  • Google Analytics: Audience measurement, pages visited, visit duration, visitor origin. The data is anonymised. Duration: 13 months maximum.

You can disable Google Analytics via the official extension: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.
legal.privacy.a8:
Some pages embed elements from third-party platforms (share buttons, videos). These platforms may place their own cookies on your device:

  • Facebook / Meta
  • LinkedIn
  • Twitter / X
  • YouTube (where videos are embedded)

Alivaon has no control over these third-party cookies. We invite you to consult the privacy policies of these platforms.
legal.privacy.a9:
Alivaon uses service providers as part of its activities. These processors act solely on Alivaon's instructions and are bound by confidentiality clauses:

  • OVHcloud - Web hosting and data storage
  • Email service provider - Management of transactional emails (contact confirmations, notifications)
  • Google Analytics - Audience analysis (anonymised data)

portfolio.show.step4_content: After going live, we trained the client's teams to use the software. A maintenance contract ensures ongoing support, evolutions and long-term availability of the tool.
